original_report: 会员年限：按年份差计算，生日未到时多算一年。
diagnosis: 周年/年龄计算需比较月日，生日未到要减一年。
patch_diff:
--- a/solution.py
+++ b/solution.py
@@ -1,3 +1,6 @@
 import datetime
 def tenure(start, today):
-    return today.year - start.year
+    a = today.year - start.year
+    if (today.month, today.day) < (start.month, start.day):
+        a -= 1
+    return a
applicable_conditions: 周岁/周年需校验证生日
